headline: [Exclusive] International fuel surcharge to be cut in September; ANA and JAL reflect lower fuel costs | Akita Sakigake Electronic Edition
summary: All Nippon Airways and Japan Airlines will cut fuel surcharges on international routes for tickets issued in September and October. The reduction reflects lower aviation fuel costs.
why: All Nippon Airways and Japan Airlines are Japan's two largest airlines, and fuel is a major component of their operating costs.
